program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text='''def transform(grid):\n    occupied = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]\n    top = min(r for r, c in occupied)\n    bottom = max(r for r, c in occupied) + 1\n    left = min(c for r, c in occupied)\n    right = max(c for r, c in occupied) + 1\n    height = bottom - top\n    width = right - left\n    return [row[left:left + width // 2] for row in grid[top:top + height // 2]]\n'''
